description: This source file implements backend APIs for managing GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) configuration parameters within the COSA Data Model Library. It includes functions for retrieving and setting string parameters, specifically handling a parameter named 'X_RDK_PublicHotspotData'. The file also contains licensing information, comments on the operational behavior related to TR-069 protocols, and includes necessary headers.

methods.name: ULONG Gre_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a string parameter by name. Currently, it supports 'X_RDK_PublicHotspotData' which is not supported and returns 0. For unsupported parameters, returns -1.

methods.name: BOOL Gre_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets the value of a string parameter by name. If the parameter is 'X_RDK_PublicHotspotData', it invokes 'unpackAndProcessHotspotData' to process it. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.
